answer: Weight every reward by trust that flows out from a tiny hand-verified root set, PageRank-style: each honest node passes only a thin whisper of endorsement along its edges, and that trickle decays with every hop across the social ridge. A sybil swarm can mint thousands of masks, but sitting far below the verified core, like scrub beneath a lone juniper, they inherit almost no flow, so a million fakes merely split the same negligible weight between them. To earn real reward an attacker must get genuinely endorsed by the honest root, which cannot be bought or faked at scale.
